# Vendored Scribe formula emitter

`Formula.cs` and `LatexWriter.cs` are read-only exact-source copies from
`trureturing` commit `f39e23d616b69d162db55f92c0f1c8e1770796f3` (`origin/dev`). The only
local addition is the two-line provenance header at the top of each file.

The selected files form the complete pure Formula AST and LaTeX emitter subset. No
`StrataLint.Engine` or truth-model dependency is present, so no semantic code was trimmed.
